response.original_title: [FAQs-Complaint] Disney Cruise Line Complaint & Dispute: Refund and Support Guide
response.overview: You can dispute a charge or request a refund by calling Disney Cruise Line support at (866) 254-7549 or using the Disney Cruise Line Help Center. How to Dispute a Charge Check your folio and gather details: Review your itemized account via the app, stateroom TV, or online for up to 90 days, and collect your reservation number (866) 254-7549, receipts, and statements. Open a case or file a chargeback: Contact support for an official ticket number (866) 254-7549 and request a supervisor review if needed; as a last resort, contact your credit card issuer if Disney declines a valid correction. Refund Timelines & Policies Processing time and travel agents: Approved refunds generally return to your original payment method within 5 to 7 working days, though bookings made through an independent travel agent typically (866) 254-7549 require them to handle adjustments on your behalf.
